description: Attach a tracking op (target 'ball', region 120,90,40,40, [0.5s, 1.5s]) to a project and verify the op is carried in the native blender bundle and applied to the generated script; the actual tracking execution is binary-gated and its headless status is reported honestly.
notes: See gap.editor-track-object-launch-coverage: the launch set's only tracking mapping is experimental and unverified headless; the scenario asserts what IS verifiable without the binary (op storage, script generation) and gates execution.
